dedupe_keys.name: india climate and energy dashboard iced niti aayog national energy supply power sector distribution utility and emissions indicators

description: The India Climate and Energy Dashboard (ICED) of NITI Aayog brings together official data on India's energy system and climate. Its menus cover fuel sources (coal reserves, imports, production, consumption, pricing and transport; oil; gas; solar and wind resource potential; hydro reservoirs; nuclear; bioenergy and storage), end use by sector, and a detailed power sector section: installed capacity, power plant details, generation, plant load factors, forced and planned outages, CO2 emissions, pipeline capacity and technical parameters such as heat rate, ramp rates, fuel linkage and flue gas desulphurisation status. For distribution companies it shows peak demand, hourly demand curves, power purchase costs, consumers and connected load, tariffs, billing and collection efficiency, AT&C and T&D losses and financial health; it also lists transmission lines and substations, greenhouse gas emissions by sector and water availability. Coverage: India, national and state level. Format and access: interactive charts with PDF and spreadsheet download buttons and a data request form; free. Licence: not stated on the pages read; the disclaimer says data come mainly from government sources, with some derived or assumed values documented in the ICED manual, and are not guaranteed. Caveats: the site is a script-driven application, so only its menus and disclaimer were read. Simulation uses: plant, outage, demand and utility data for capacity planning and resilience studies of India's power system. Related records: Energy Access Explorer (platform-energy-access-explorer-wri) covers Indian districts for access planning.
